[03-06 Dec 2026 / All sessions at TBarM]{.eyebrow}

The full session lineup will be posted on the [sessions page](sessions/index.qmd) once the 2026 program is finalized. The shape of the week is already set.

::: {.day-block}
[Thursday, 03 Dec]{.day-date}

### Arrival

Check in at TBarM through the afternoon. The workshop opens with dinner, introductions, and an overview of how the two session days will run.
:::

::: {.day-block}
[Friday, 04 Dec]{.day-date}

### Session day one

A full day of 50-minute sessions. Each session runs the same way: about 25 minutes of hands-on demonstration, 15 minutes of what-and-why, and 10 minutes of audience input. Meals and breaks are on site with the whole group.
:::

::: {.day-block}
[Saturday, 05 Dec]{.day-date}

### Session day two

A second full day of sessions in the same format, closing with dinner and time to keep the arguments going informally.
:::

::: {.day-block}
[Sunday, 06 Dec]{.day-date}

### Wrap-up

Breakfast, an informal wrap-up of what the room is taking home, and checkout.
:::

::: {.note-panel}
**Presenting this year?** Send your session title, a short description, and any materials you want attendees to have to [sd33@txstate.edu](mailto:sd33@txstate.edu). Materials get posted to the [resources page](resources/index.qmd), and your session will be listed here.
:::
